verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Supabase Auth acting as an OAuth client to external providers (social login, custom OAuth/OIDC providers) and issuing JWTs verifiable through a JWKS URL with customizable claims. Nothing documents Supabase Auth acting as a spec-compliant OAuth authorization server that remote agents could use against an MCP server, such as third-party client authorization, consent, or client registration. A community comment asking to use Supabase Auth as an IdP suggests this role was not available; JWKS and claim hooks are only building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can put a spec-compliant OAuth authorization flow in front of my MCP server so remote agents connect with scoped, verifiable tokens
